newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates close up on tight liquidity.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates close up on tight liquidity.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates ended higher on Tuesday amid tight liquidity as money demand rose after a typhoon holiday on Monday, dealers said.
The overnight interbank rate closed 7.844 percent against Saturday's 7.522 finish, while 30-day commercial paper surged to 8.25 percent against 7.5 percent.
Dealers said liquidity also became tight after T$13.815 billion worth of repurchase agreement on securities conducted previously by the central bank matured on Tuesday.
